llm.relevance_to_user: 这篇论文是临床结局研究，不涉及股骨柄的应力遮挡、微动或有限元分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical case series on dislocation rates after total hip arthroplasty with dual-mobility cups; it does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion, or any biomechanical parameters relevant to femoral stem design or FEA.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估双动杯在全髋置换术中的脱位率

summary_en.motivation: This study aimed to prospectively evaluate the dislocation rate after primary total hip arthroplasty using a dual-mobility cup.
summary_en.method: A prospective multicentre series of patients receiving cementless primary THA with dual-mobility cups was analyzed for complications.
summary_en.result: The dual-mobility cup showed a low dislocation rate at follow-up.
summary_en.validation: Clinical follow-up without biomechanical testing or FE modeling.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文将高斯过程与贝叶斯推断结合用于结构动力学不确定性量化，方法可迁移至植入物生物力学设计中的代理建模与UQ。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on structural dynamics (e.g., vibration, frequency response) rather than implant biomechanics or FEA surrogate for stress/strain prediction.

summary_zh.motivation: 结构动力学分析中计算成本高，需高效不确定性量化方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出两级高斯过程与贝叶斯推断框架，分层处理参数与模型不确定性。
summary_zh.result: 在数值算例中准确量化了频率响应不确定性，计算效率显著提升。
summary_zh.validation: 通过标准结构动力学数值基准验证方法精度与效率。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently quantify uncertainties in structural dynamic analysis where high-fidelity simulations are computationally expensive.
summary_en.method: A two-level Gaussian process framework combined with Bayesian inference is proposed to hierarchically handle parameter and model uncertainties.
summary_en.result: The method accurately quantifies uncertainty in frequency response functions while substantially reducing computational cost on numerical benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on standard structural dynamics numerical benchmarks comparing predicted uncertainty intervals with Monte Carlo reference solutions.

papers.title: Exploring a Deep Learning Approach on the Teaching and Learning of Introductory Physics
papers.abstract: The main goal of this paper is to explore the effectiveness of an experimental learning approach in an introductory physics course regarding to student’s academic achievement.  Research articles point out that learning difficulty about science basic concepts, impact both, the quality of the skills and knowledge learned and hinder students’ retention in science basic courses.  For this research, Bachelor’s Degree students of Natural Sciences, Chemistry, Bio Medical, Biology, Computer Sciences, Medical and Engineering Technology programs were selected.  The teaching methodology used was named Learning Two Time Strategy (LTTS).  The methodology consisted in applying active learning strategies, but at the same time lowering considerably the time for the traditional teaching process.  This strategy allowed students to dedicate more time for classroom learning by increasing in about two thirds the active learning periods.  The period assigned for instructions was turned into active learning sessions.  Active learning was based in different strategies like “Context-Rich Problems”.  The methodological concept used was causal comparative (or ex post facto).  Seven hundred and sixty-seven (767) students from two private universities in Puerto Rico participated in the study.  The students were divided in two groups.  The base group of 407 students was not exposed to didactic strategy.  Another group of 360 students was exposed to the strategy.  The statistical test shed a significant difference in students’ academic achievement (value of p = 0.007) measured by the score of their final grades in the course. As a result, the group that was submitted to the strategy showed positive results in the student’s evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索主动学习策略对物理课程学业成绩的影响
summary_zh.method: 采用因果比较法，将学生分为实验组和对照组进行教学实验
summary_zh.result: 实验组学生的期末成绩显著高于对照组（p=0.007）
summary_zh.validation: 通过767名学生的成绩统计检验验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate whether an active learning strategy improves academic achievement in introductory physics courses.
summary_en.method: A causal-comparative design was used, comparing final grades of 767 students divided into control and experimental groups.
summary_en.result: The experimental group showed significantly higher final grades (p=0.007) than the control group.
summary_en.validation: Statistical hypothesis testing on student grades from two universities.
